metric: valid_direction AND coarse_direction_deviation_deg <=10, divided by ALL windows

interpolation.method: 4 nearest IDW, power2, physical metre coordinates
interpolation.near_domain: inside low-altitude 3D convex hull, z<=10m, nearest measured point <=2m
interpolation.high_domain: linear interpolation only on x=y=0, z=10..120m

z_display: z for z<=10; 10+15*ln(z/10)/ln(12) for z>10. Interpolation is performed BEFORE display compression.
excluded: 环境噪音.smq: no source position
warning: Not actual dynamic accuracy or localization probability. All development and heldout labels pooled for descriptive mapping; no independent validation of interpolation.
